title: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 4 and the Twenty-Four-Cell Conjecture
description: We prove that every packing of unit balls in four-dimensional Euclidean space has density below 0.630996, and that the Voronoi cell of a centre has volume at least 8, with equality only for the 24-cell, in a list of cases: all contact configurations, every centre with at most 23 or at least 28 neighbours within the square root of 6, the listed radial profiles of 27 neighbours, an explicit neighbourhood of the root system D4, and every configuration of 24 neighbours whose directions lie within 1/48 of the root system, with no limit on the push-outs. The remaining cases reduce to two explicit statements for 24 to 27 neighbours, which stay open, so the twenty-four-cell conjecture and the optimality of D4 are not proved. The archive contains the paper, Lean 4 proofs of the finite arithmetic and a Julia verification suite.
